question:

| Input | Value |

| Ten-day 99% VaR, average of the 60 most recent days | 15.00 |
| Ten-day 99% VaR, average of the 250 most recent days | 11.50 |
| Ten-day 99% stressed VaR, previous day | 61.00 |
| Ten-day 99% stressed VaR, average of the 60 most recent days | 19.50 |
| Ten-day 99.9% stressed VaR, previous day | 88.00 |
| Multiplier on VaR, $m_{c}$ | 3.50 |
| Multiplier on stressed VaR, $m_{s}$ | 3.00 |
